name: Apollo North Pipeline

values.EndLocation: Apollo Power Generation Facility, Middleton Township, near Bowling Green
values.DataCenterNotes: The pipeline serves the Apollo gas power plant that Williams is building in Middleton Township, Wood County, Ohio, next to a Meta data center. A July 2026 local news report says Meta is the plant's only power customer. The Williams project page names this North line as its own Ohio Power Siting Board filing for the plant but does not mention data centers itself.

researcher_notes: Williams lists an Apollo North Pipeline as its own filing with the Ohio Power Siting Board for the Apollo power plant, separate from the Apollo South Pipeline, which is already a row. No existing row matches. The Williams page gives no length, diameter, start point or route, so those stay blank and the route is marked no route. The Williams page does not mention data centers. The tie comes through the plant: a July 2026 local news report says the plant sits beside Meta's data center and sells power only to Meta. That report describes the South line and does not mention the North line, so the tie is indirect and confidence is medium. The sponsor is Will-Power Pipeline OH, a Williams subsidiary. The case number 26-0275-GA-BLN came from an earlier run and was not confirmed here. Status is proposed because only the filing is public.
